title: Vacuum--fourth-chaos mixing creates a divergent gap below the exact projective Wick shift

variational_gap.notation: Let V_N=integral :phi_N^4: dx, sigma_N^2=E(V_N^2)=Theta(N^5), W_N=V_N+6C_N^2 and H_N=H0+gW_N for fixed g>0
variational_gap.trial_vector: For fixed 0<a<=1/128 use psi_N=1-a V_N/sigma_N; its squared norm is exactly 1+a^2 because V_N is centered
variational_gap.exact_rayleigh_identity: Writing h_N=<V_N,H0 V_N> and m3_N=E(V_N^3), the normalized Rayleigh quotient satisfies R_N-6gC_N^2=[a^2 h_N/sigma_N^2-2ga sigma_N+ga^2 m3_N/sigma_N^2]/(1+a^2)
variational_gap.free_energy_bound: V_N is pure fourth Wiener chaos supported on frequencies at most N, so h_N<=4 omega_max(N) sigma_N^2 with omega_max(N)=O(N)
variational_gap.third_moment_bound: Fourth-chaos hypercontractivity gives ||V_N||_3<=4||V_N||_2 and therefore |m3_N|<=64 sigma_N^3
variational_gap.gap: For 0<a<=1/128 the linear and third-moment terms are at most -(3/2)ga sigma_N; since sigma_N=Theta(N^(5/2)) dominates omega_max(N), R_N<=6gC_N^2-c_(g,a)N^(5/2) for all sufficiently large N
variational_gap.ground_energy_consequence: E_N-6gC_N^2<=-c_(g,a)N^(5/2), so the exact conditional-expectation shift does not track the interacting ground energy up to O(1)
variational_gap.ceiling: The trial gives a one-sided divergent gap, not the sharp asymptotic of E_N. It does not exclude recentering by E_N+O(1), singular dressing, a non-Gaussian measure or a changed representation
